Caveat: per secondary summaries the Barel facts were a shekel deposit linked to a foreign currency; the extension to an FX-denominated deposit rests on s.1 ("הפרשי שער" count as linkage) and s.125C(a), as TX2-01 already treats both alike; the lead may prefer to keep it narrowed.
